newsitem.title: UK: Gehe has 0.16 pct of Lloyds Chemists.
newsitem.headline: Gehe has 0.16 pct of Lloyds Chemists.

text.p: German pharmaceutical wholesaler Gehe AG said on Monday that it had received valid acceptances of its offer for Britain's Lloyds Chemists Plc from shareholders representing approximately 0.16 percent of Lloyds' ordinary shares.
In a statement Gehe said that by 1500 GMT on Monday it had also received valid aceptances from shareholders representing around 0.99 percent of the company's preference shares.
It added that the offer had been extended until January 10, 1997.
Pharmacy chain operator and wholesaler Lloyds is at the centre of a takeover battle between Gehe and its UK rival Unichem Plc.
Gehe's offer values the company at 650.6 million stg while Unichem's bid is worth 657.6 million stg. Unichem has extended its offer until January 3, 1997.
